name: private-directory-server
description: A secure local directory browser with previews, streaming, and optional uploads.

scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-deps.js && npm run build && node dist/src/server.js
scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-deps.js && npm run build && node --test dist/test/**/*.test.js
scripts.check: node scripts/ensure-deps.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.package: node scripts/ensure-deps.js && npm run build && node dist/scripts/package-release.js
scripts.menu: node scripts/ensure-deps.js && npm run build && node dist/scripts/menu.js
